index.source: A. Borzsonyi, Z. Heiner, M. P. Kalashnikov, A. P. Kovacs, K. Osvay, Appl. Opt. 47, 4856 (2008) (refractiveindex.info main/N2/Borzsonyi), 273 K and 1 bar

n2Electronic.source: electronic (instantaneous) n2 at 1 bar and 273 K near 800 nm; the original code cites the compilation of Lehmeier 1985 / Borzsonyi 2010 / Wahlstrand 2012; values differ by ~20 % between sources; not re-checked

ionization.source: ionisation potential: NIST Atomic Spectra Database (as cited by the original code); orbital l and zEff: standard ADK / PPT choices; the effective charge of the molecule is an empirical choice
ionization.uncertainty: ionisation potentials are tabulated constants; the effective charge and orbital l are model choices

rotation.source: rotational constants: NIST / Herzberg (as cited by the original code); polarisability anisotropy: Bridge and Buckingham, Proc. R. Soc. A 295, 334 (1966), as cited by the original code; nuclear-spin weights from the molecular symmetry

dephasing.source: rotational coherence time at 1 bar and 293 K, scaled as 1/p and sqrt(T); typical value, the original code did not record a source; the 2011 fs/ps rotational CARS measurements of self-broadened N2 and O2 (1-20 atm) are the place to check it
